title: [Quality in shoulder surgery: is return to play all that matters?].
journal: Der Chirurg; Zeitschrift fur alle Gebiete der operativen Medizen

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: Pathologies of the shoulder joint present a significant burden on not only the affected individual but also the healthcare system as a whole. This article serves to delineate the outcomes that patients expect from undergoing shoulder surgery and the results that occur following shoulder surgery.
